label: Net-new: openhuman-full vendors twenty-one crates, not five; the five the topic names are a subset.
Net-new: openhuman-full differs from openhuman-main only by vendor/, 21332 files against zero; every other top-level directory carries the identical count.
Net-new: openhuman-tui is in both trees and the plan already cites it; openhuman-full adds only a build log proving it compiles.
Net-new: every one of the twenty-one vendor crates is GPL-3.0, so the whole tree is read-only design evidence and the plan 003 reaches the right conclusion for the wrong reason.
003: the TUI activity model is six states with one marker glyph each; the plan seven groups are the better fit and the marker table is what to mirror.
003: safe_text drops control characters while the plan theme::printable replaces them; replacing is better for a snapshot test and the plan should record why.
009: tinyskills is a host-independent skill-bundle parser, the one vendor crate whose subject the plan has and whose implementation it lacks; value high, size M.
011: tinychannels is a full multi-channel runtime at 273669 lines, far past the plan link roster and send queue; value low, size XL.
Net-new: tinyeventqueues is the highest-value crate the plan has no counterpart for, because the plan only has an outbound send queue and no inbound dedupe; value high, size M.
Net-new: tinydocs is the only document-output path in any of the ten repos and no 003 phase produces a document; value medium, size M.
Net-new: tinybus is the architectural idea behind the whole vendor tree and the plan runtime has no bus; value medium, size L.

Net-new: six crates are out of scope by the skip list or the plan own deferral and should be recorded rather than re-examined: tinyconnectors, tinybox, tinycomputer, tinyhosts, tinyhumans-sdk and tinymcp.
Net-new: tinywallet is a liability rather than a candidate, because the plan 006 defers pay and a wallet is a payment surface with no approval rung above it.
012: the test corpus to mirror is one *_tests.rs beside every module, complementary to the plan 33 behaviour-keyed scenario files.
013 and 014: the upgrade path the plan lacks is a feature-forwarding check, because a bare workspace dependency silently widened the default feature set.
